scope: Task-level state aggregation and live macOS Sources diagnostic consumption

verifiedRules: Active work takes precedence over terminal sibling work items.
All observed work may be completed while the task lifecycle remains active.
Failure wins only when no work item is active.
An empty task remains idle with no observed outcome.
Archiving preserves unresolved observations and never fabricates completion.
Input order and states owned by another task do not affect the projection.

verification.macOSBuild: Anchor macOS arm64 Debug build succeeded with CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
verification.headlessLifecycleE2E: passed with restart and no replay
verification.faultInjectionSoak: 8 turns passed with process restarts, atomic replacement and in-place truncation
verification.macOSAccessibilityTree: live running, completed, restart-restored and attention-coexistence states observed

limitations: The runtime lifecycle events were synthetic privacy-minimal Codex JSONL rows.
The needs-input and prior-failure UI state used an isolated persisted fixture, not a real Codex event.
The current Codex adapter does not yet emit needs-input or explicit failure attention facts.
iPhone and transport consumers do not use AnchorTaskState yet.
